_comment: Retuned for free no-card GPUs (Lightning L4 / any provider). 768x448 (both dims divisible by 32, LTX-safe), 24fps. PER-CHARACTER LoRA: put trained LoRAs in ComfyUI/models/loras and map them in 'characters'. AUDIO: 'voices' maps a character to a reference voice wav for cloning; per-shot 'dialogue'+'voice' are consumed by voice_lipsync.py AFTER rendering (render_film ignores them). 'music' is an optional bg track (or null). Flow: render_film.py -> voice_lipsync.py -> film with sound.

shots.prompt: wide establishing shot of a neon city at dawn, slow camera drift, cinematic, volumetric light, film grain
shots.negative: blurry, distorted, low quality, watermark, text

shots.prompt: extreme close-up of the hero's eyes slowly opening, shallow depth of field, catchlight, cinematic
